event_chain.summary: Bridge message path abused, root cause not confirmed
rsETH released from bridge to attacker

summary: On April 18, 2026 an attacker drained 116,500 rsETH (about $292 million) from Kelp DAO's LayerZero-based rsETH bridge by calling lzReceive on LayerZero's EndpointV2 so that Kelp's bridge contract released the tokens. Kelp's emergency multisig paused contracts about 46 minutes later, blocking two further attempts worth about $100 million. The theft spread losses across DeFi lending platforms that accepted rsETH. The attacker wallet was funded through Tornado Cash; later reports tied the attack to Lazarus.
